description: Lava Smart 4 has been launched in India on Monday. It is offered in two colour options and has a 5,000mAh battery. The new Lava Smart 4 features a 6.56-inch display and has 4G connectivity. It has an 8-megapixel rear camera. It runs on an octa-core Unisoc processor. The new phone is available in a single RAM and storage option in the country.
title: Lava Smart 4 Launched in India With 5,000mAh Battery, 6.56-Inch Display: Price, Specifications

description: Australia’s financial crime regulator has suspended Cryptolink’s registration for three months, forcing the operator to temporarily shut down its Bitcoin ATMs across the country. AUSTRAC said the company failed to meet basic anti-money laundering reporting obligations and did not respond adequately to information requests. The action follows an enforceable undertaking signed by Cryptolink in 2025 and comes as Australian authorities continue tightening oversight of crypto ATM operators.
title: Australia Shuts Down Cryptolink Bitcoin ATMs Over ‘Basic Reporting’ Lapses

description: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026 brings down the prices of several gaming laptops from HP, Lenovo and Asus. The deals include machines equipped with Nvidia GeForce RTX 2050, RTX 3050 and RTX 4050 GPUs, with effective prices starting at Rs. 70,990. Buyers can also benefit from advertised bank discounts of up to Rs. 20,000 and exchange savings of up to Rs. 10,000. Eligible HDFC Bank transactions offer an additional 10 percent instant discount, subject to applicable terms.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Best Deals on Gaming Laptops from Asus, HP, and Lenovo Under Rs 1 Lakh

description: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026 is currently live in India. Many 5G phones priced under Rs. 70,000, including the Pixel 10, Xiaomi 17T and Oppo Reno 15, are discounted in the ongoing sale. HDFC Bank users will get an instant discount of up to 10 percent on purchases made using credit and EMI transactions. Buyers can also avail of Amazon Pay-based offers and exchange discounts.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Best Deals on 5G Smartphones Under Rs. 70,000

description: The Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026 brings discounts on mirrorless cameras from Canon, Sony and Fujifilm across a range of price points. The Canon EOS R50 is the most affordable model in this selection at an effective Rs. 62,240, while the Sony ILCE-6700 is available for Rs. 1,14,240. At the premium end, the Canon R50V White and Fujifilm X-M5 Silver are priced at Rs. 1,65,240 and Rs. 1,84,250, respectively. The sale also includes offers on action cameras, security cameras and camera accessories.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Best Deals on Mirrorless Cameras

description: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026 allows shoppers to pick up flagship headphones at considerably lower prices. The online marketplace is also giving bank discounts and exchange offers on select models to give customers a reason to purchase new models. Other offers include no-cost EMI options, Amazon coupons and exchange offers. Here are our top picks for the best deals on premium headphones on Amazon right now.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Best Deals on Premium Headphones

description: Fire TVs are slowly becoming a popular option for viewers in India. The operating system offers a straightforward way to access streaming services, live TV and other connected features from a single interface. While primarily developed by Amazon, many brands offer Fire TVs across a range of screen sizes, price segments, and display technologies. So, if buying a new Fire TV has been on your wishlist, then there are several models available at discounted prices during the Amazon Great Freedom Sale.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Best Deals on Fire TVs

description: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026 is offering various tablets under Rs. 30,000. The company is offering an instant discount of 10 percent with an HDFC Bank credit card and credit card EMI transactions, allowing you to maximise your savings. For reference, the Samsung Galaxy Tab A11+ is available at a discounted price of Rs. 23,999, instead of its listed price of Rs. 27,999. Similarly, you can get your hands on the Lenovo Idea Tab with a stylus at a relatively low price of Rs. 24,999. You can also get the model with cellular connectivity.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Best Deals on Tablets Under Rs. 30,000 From Samsung, Lenovo, and More

description: Boltt has revealed the camera and AI features of its upcoming Ace 5G and Evo smartphones ahead of their August 25 India launch. The Ace 5G will feature a 64-megapixel rear camera with an f/1.8 aperture, while the Evo will use a 50-megapixel main camera. Both phones will have 8-megapixel selfie cameras with Real Tone support. Their AI features include Face Unblur, Night Mode, AI Portraits, Circle to Search and Google Lens, with Gemini powering several on-screen tools.
title: Boltt Ace 5G and Evo Camera Details Revealed Ahead of August 25 India Launch

description: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026 has listed various gaming monitors of different sizes at discounted prices. For example, if you are looking for a 27-inch gaming monitor, you can get your hands on the Lenovo Legion R27fc-30, LG 27GS60QC, or Lenovo Legion R27qe Gen 2 at relatively low prices of Rs. 15,290, Rs. 15,499, and Rs. 14,999, respectively. Additionally, you can avail of an instant discount of 10 percent with an HDFC Bank credit card and credit card EMI transactions.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Best Deals on Gaming Monitors From Lenovo, BenQ, LG, and More

description: Brazil’s central bank has proposed new safeguards requiring virtual asset service providers to place precautionary holds of up to 24 hours on certain crypto transfers to foreign platforms and self-custody wallets. The measure would apply to amounts exceeding $10,000 (roughly Rs. 9.5 lakh) received in a single transaction or across a customer’s transactions in one day. If adopted,
title: Brazil's Central Bank Proposes 24-Hour Holds on High-Value Crypto Transfers

description: Amazon Freedom Sale 2026 brings massive discounts on several mechanical and semi-mechanical gaming keyboards. In recent years, mechanical keyboards have become a popular choice among gamers and PC users for their tactile feedback, distinct key feel and responsiveness. The individual mechanical switches placed beneath the keys come with different switch types, offering varying levels of actuation, sound and feedback. During the sale, shoppers can buy a wide selection of mechanical keyboards at considerably lower rates than their usual market prices.
title: Amazon Freedom Sale 2026: Best Deals on Mechanical Keyboards From RedGear, EvoFox, and More

description: Redmi 17 5G and Redmi 17 4G have been launched in select global markets. While the Redmi 17 4G is offered in Black, Deep Blue, Lotus Purple, and Oak Green colour options, the Redmi 17 5G is available for purchase in Black, Deep Blue, and Vivid Orange shades. Both phones sport the same 6.9-inch HD+ (720 x 1,600 pixels) display, offering up to 120Hz refresh rate, up to 240Hz touch sampling rate, 16.7 million colours, 83 percent NTSC coverage, up to 825 nits peak brightness, and Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection. Qualcomm’s 4nm octa-core Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 chipset powers the Redmi 17 5G.
title: Redmi 17 5G Launched Globally With 7,500mAh Battery, Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 Chipset, Redmi 17 4G Tags Along: Price, Features

description: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has commented on the decision to not release a physical disc version of Grand Theft Auto 6. Zelnick said that discs don't make sense for the consumer in the case of big games. The executive, however, left the door open for a GTA 6 disc version at some point in the future.
title: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick Explains Why GTA 6 Is Not Getting a Disc Version

description: BTCPay Server has temporarily blocked remote access to Lightning Network nodes running LND after a vulnerability was exploited to obtain credentials and steal funds. The restriction affects external wallets accessing nodes through BTCPay’s domain and Tor onion URL on Docker deployments. BTCPay said Lightning payments can continue while developers work on restoring remote access. Node operators have also been advised to audit their systems for suspicious transactions and channel activity.
title: BTCPay Server Blocks Remote Lightning Node Access After LND Vulnerability Exploited by Hackers

description: Apple Pay is reportedly nearing its India debut, with Business Standard suggesting a launch around late September or October. The service could initially work with Visa and Mastercard credit cards, while UPI payments may be unavailable. Apple is also said to be negotiating transaction fees with major banks, with the proposed charge coming from interchange revenue rather than customers or merchants. Payments industry executive Amrish Rau expects the service to enter India this year as credit card transactions continue to grow alongside UPI.
title: Apple Pay Could Launch in India by October Without UPI Support: Report

description: A retailer listing has surfaced for the Redmi Note 17 4G. The listing shows several key details about the upcoming 4G smartphone. It is shown with a 6.83-inch AMOLED 1.5K display with a 120Hz refresh rate. It has an octa-core Qualcomm Snapdragon 6s 4G Gen 2 processor, a 7,700mAh battery and support for 45W wired fast charging. It has a 50-megapixel rear camera unit.
title: Redmi Note 17 4G Price Revealed via Retail Listing; Could Feature 6.83-Inch Display, 7,700mAh Battery

description: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+ and Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra renders suggest that the tablets will retain a familiar front design, with the Ultra continuing to use a notch. The leaked wallpaper features a blue and purple gradient with a central S, while both models could launch in grey and silver. The tablets are tipped to use MediaTek's Dimensity 9500 chipset and One UI 9, with the Ultra recently appearing on Geekbench. The series could also feature large AMOLED displays, sizeable batteries and S Pen support.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra Leak Suggests Notch Will Return on Flagship Tablet

description: Final Fantasy VII Revelation, the third and final chapter in the Final Fantasy 7 remake trilogy, is confirmed to get a new look at Gamescom Opening Night Live. The event, which will kick off Gamescom 2026, will take place on August 25 in Cologne, Germany.
title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation Will Get a New Look at Gamescom Opening Night Live This Month

description: Lenovo Lecoo P900A is listed with a price tag of CNY 899 (roughly Rs. 12,000) on JD.Com. It runs on the company's ZUXOS software. It features an 8-inch display with HD+ resolution. The new tablet features an unspecified MediaTek processor. It carries 8GB of RAM and 128GB of storage. It has a 5,000mAh battery and is offered in 8GB RAM + 128GB storage option.
title: Lenovo Lecoo Mini With 8-Inch Display Listed in China; Price and Specifications Revealed

description: Bitcoin remained near Rs. 61.9 lakh on Monday after weaker-than-expected US jobs data revived expectations of Federal Reserve rate cuts. Analysts said thin trading volumes and cautious spot demand could limit gains, while US CPI and PPI data due later this week could provide the next major market catalyst.
title: Bitcoin Steadies Around $65,000 as Weak US Jobs Data Revives Fed Rate Cut Expectations

description: Motorola Edge 70 Neo has surfaced in leaked renders showing a flat display, centred selfie camera and a square rear camera module. The handset is shown in four finishes, including dark green, light blue, olive green and pale pink. One rear camera carries 200-megapixel branding, while three sensors are visible overall. The smartphone had earlier appeared in Motorola's Android 17 beta testing programme in India. It has also been linked to the Motorola Edge 2026, although the specifications may differ.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Neo Leaked Renders Hints at 200-Megapixel Camera and Four Colour Options

description: OnePlus 16 is scheduled to launch later this year as the successor to the OnePlus 15. Although the launch has been confirmed, the company has yet to share any details about the upcoming flagship. Fresh certification details, however, reveal support for several cellular bands. The certification, filed by Oppo in China, confirm support for GSM, WCDMA, 5G, and WLAN. The OnePlus 16, notably, was previously confirmed to introduce three “exclusive gaming technologies”.
title: OnePlus 16 Reportedly Gets Radio Certification in China; Tipped to Feature Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro SoC

description: Moto Pad 70 launched in India with a 12.1-inch 2.5K display with a 90Hz refresh rate and carries a 10,200mAh battery with 68W wired charging support. The Moto Pad 70 is equipped with a MediaTek Dimensity 6400 chipset, and it includes a Moto Pen in the box. It has quad speakers with Dolby Atmos support. It has a 13-megapixel rear camera. It features an 8-megapixel front-facing camera for selfies and video chats.
title: Moto Pad 70 Launched in India With 2.5K Display, 10,200mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Boat CineHead F1 series has been unveiled by the Indian tech firm. The new lineup includes two new projectors, namely Boat CineHead F1 Pro and CineHead F1. On Monday, the company launched the CineHead F1 Pro model, while the standard model will be launched later this month. The new projector is currently available at an introductory price via the company’s website. The Boat CineHead F1 series projectors are the first from the Indian tech firm to ship with Google TV. Moreover, the projectors support dual-band 2.5GHz and 5GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 5.1 for wireless connectivity. Both projectors are powered by a MediaTek chipset.
title: Boat CineHead F1 Pro Projector Launched in India With Google TV 5.0, Up to 4K Support: Price, Specifications

description: Apple is planning a major overhaul of its entire Apple Watch lineup, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman writes in the latest edition of his weekly newsletter ‘Power On’. The company is reportedly working on new styles for the future Apple Watch models. Moreover, the tech giant is also said to be considering bringing back ceramic case options for its wearables, which could be launched later this year or in 2027. Similarly, Apple is also planning to launch the new Apple Watch models in new colour options and band options, along with “a series of new health and fitness-related upgrades”, Gurman highlights. Apart from this, Apple’s industrial design team is also reportedly exploring a “broader rethink of its smartwatches over the past year or so”.
title: Apple Reportedly Plans Major Apple Watch Lineup Overhaul, Considers Ceramic Case Options, Screen-Free Design

description: Apple’s first foldable iPhone could arrive with silver and dark blue finishes, based on leaked third-party camera protectors shared by a tipster. The images also appear to reveal a dual-camera rear setup. Previous reports suggest Apple is working on a crease-resistant inner display using a liquid metal or 3D-printed hinge. The device could measure 4.5mm when folded and feature a titanium and aluminium frame. Pricing is expected to start above $2,000 (roughly Rs. 1,90,500), while analysts predict strong demand for Apple’s entry into foldables.
title: Apple's First Foldable iPhone Could Come in Silver and Dark Blue, Leak Suggests

description: iQOO 16T is currently being tested with a cooling solution that combines liquid and air cooling. The upcoming handset is said to retain a 200-megapixel primary camera but lack a dedicated periscope telephoto lens. A previous leak suggested that the iQOO 16T is undergoing testing with Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 (SM8950) chipset. It could include an inbuilt cooling fan.
title: iQOO 16T Tipped to Feature 200-Megapixel Rear Camera Unit, New Liquid-Air Cooling System

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 pre-orders have had an "exceptional" start, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has said. The executive reffirmed GTA 6's November 19 release date and said the game's launch would usher in a “a new era of growth” for the company.
title: Take-Two Says GTA 6 Pre-Orders Had 'Exceptional' Start, Reaffirms November 19 Release Date

description: Anthropic has announced that it is making Claude Code more autonomous, with the auto mode soon becoming the default. The feature allows Claude to execute coding tasks without repeatedly asking users for permission, while a classifier evaluates tool calls and blocks actions that are considered irreversible. Anthropic says auto mode has performed better than manual permission reviews in its testing. The company has also introduced additional safeguards covering prompt injection, data exfiltration, destructive Git commands, and sensitive data access.
title: Claude Code Auto Mode to Become Default for Pro, Max, and Team Plans; Anthropic Says It Is Safer

description: iQOO Z11S and iQOO Neo 11 Ultra will go on sale in China on August 18 at 7:00 pm local time (4:30 pm IST), the Vivo sub-brand announced on Monday. The upcoming iQOO Neo 11 Ultra will be offered in “Light White, Shadow Black, and Wind Chaser” (translated from Chinese) colour options. On the other hand, the iQOO Z11S will be available in black, green, and white colourways. The iQOO Neo 11 Ultra is confirmed to be equipped with a 9,100mAh battery. It will also boast a 2K resolution flat display on the front. On the other hand, the Vivo sub-brand has announced that the iQOO Z11S will be its first smartphone to be backed by a 10,000mAh battery.
title: iQOO Z11S Confirmed to Launch Alongside the Neo 11 Ultra; Design and Key Specifications Revealed

description: The Moto G Max is expected to launch soon as the company’s latest edition to the G-series lineup. The launch date of the upcoming handset has been announced. The Moto G Max has now appeared on Flipkart, revealing its key specifications and colour options. It is confirmed to sport a 6.72-inch FHD+ display with a 120Hz refresh rate. The handset will be powered by a Snapdragon 6-series chipset and run on Android 16. The Moto G Max is confirmed to pack a 7,000mAh battery.
title: Moto G Max Full Specifications, Colour Options Revealed Ahead of August 14 Launch in India

description: The soaring prices of memory components have affected tech companies across the industry, with even Apple unable to absorb the costs fully. The Cupertino-based tech giant has already raised prices of several products in recent months, although the iPhone 17 series has so far avoided a similar fate in most markets. But that could change very soon. A new leak claims that Apple could announce a price hike for its flagship smartphone lineup very soon.
title: Thinking of Buying an iPhone 17? A Surprise Price Hike Might Change Your Mind
